featured_reviews.name: Rohit Maurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed with the Treatment Approach

I recently had a deeply disappointing experience at this hospital concerning my mother's health. She was admitted for one day due to a gastric issue. All her reports came back normal, and she was feeling better the next day. Despite this, the doctor insisted on keeping her admitted for an additional three days—without providing a clear medical justification.

When we asked for an explanation, we were told vaguely that she needed antibiotics and "the treatment wasn't complete." It felt more like an excuse to prolong the stay and increase the charges, rather than a decision based on genuine medical necessity.

What’s worse, when I questioned this, the doctor reacted defensively, citing her MBBS degree etc. She then asked me and my father to leave the consultation room, which was both rude and unprofessional.

This experience has left us with serious concerns about the hospital's intentions and patient care ethics. I urge others to seek a second opinion and prioritize preventive healthcare—eat well, stay active, and consult transparent medical professionals who truly have the patient’s best interest at heart.

featured_reviews.name: Amrita Kushwaha
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I had a terrible experience taking my mother for an eye check-up here. Dr. Rakshit is highly rude, egoistic, and lacks the basic empathy required of a healthcare professional.
​When I asked for a simple explanation of her diagnosis, he dismissively said, "Number aaya hai." When I asked for the details, he snapped, "Likhke diya hai padhlo" (It’s written, read it yourself). Most people cannot interpret clinical eye test abbreviations, yet he refused to provide any clarity. He even spoke about me to his nurse in Gujarati, assuming I wouldn’t understand, saying he didn’t want to explain anything to me.
​Even after the doctor turned back, the nurse was just as unhelpful. When I asked her to explain the numbers on the paper, she just pointlessly repeated, "This is the number," without any further explanation of what it meant for my mother’s vision or the lenses required.
​It is ridiculous that they charge a consultation fee only to run tests through a machine. If the doctor provides zero actual consultation, guidance, or human communication, what is the fee even for? It is shocking that an MBBS doctor and his staff have so little regard for patient sensitivity. We left feeling pathetic and completely in the dark about my mother’s eye health. Avoid this hospital if you expect a professional consultation and basic respect.

featured_reviews.name: shany kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
“My experience with this doctor was not satisfactory. Despite undergoing surgery and treatment for several months, there was no significant improvement. I was repeatedly advised to consult different doctors and visit multiple locations, which created confusion and inconvenience.
I felt there was a lack of clarity and consistency in the treatment approach. As a patient, I expected proper guidance and effective results, which unfortunately were not met.
I would advise others to seek complete information and consider a second opinion before proceeding with treatment.”
And every time he asks me to visit, he charges a consultation fee again. The fees are very high and feel unreasonable.”
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We strongly refute the claims made in this review, as they are inaccurate and do not reflect the standard of care we provide.

All treatments, including cataract surgery and follow-up care, are conducted based on established medical protocols and the patient’s specific clinical condition. 

We would also like to clarify that the cataract surgery was successful, and post-operative assessments well documented indicates that vision was restored satisfactorily and the clinical outcome was good.

Despite this, concerns of pain have been raised even after 3 months, which is not supported by our current clinical findings. We have thoroughly evaluated the patient and found no abnormalities.

For complete transparency and reassurance, we also advised seeking a second opinion.(surely does not creat confusion but some inconvenience)

However, this was declined.

We would also like to state that inappropriate and disrespectful behavior towards doctor and medical staff is not acceptable.

Consultation fees are standard across the medical profession and are transparently communicated. 

Each visit involves detailed evaluation and professional expertise. Similar to other professions—such as consulting a lawyer or a chartered accountant—professional fees are charged for each consultation based on the time, expertise, and services provided.

We  expect respectful and appropriate conduct from patients and their attendants/relatives.

On this occasion, the behavior of the patient’s relative was inappropriate and unacceptable, which made it difficult to maintain a constructive and respectful clinical interaction.

We remain committed to ethical medical care and patient safety

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been visiting this hospital for eye check-ups for the past 8 years and never faced any issue before. However, this time I consulted the evening doctor, and I was given the wrong prescription.

I got my glasses made based on that report, but I am not able to see clearly at all. This was very disappointing, especially as a regular patient. It feels like the check-up was not done properly this time.

Because of this mistake, I have wasted both time and money.

I had a very disappointing experience at this hospital. I went for an eye check-up, but the prescription given to me was incorrect. After making glasses based on their report, I am still not able to see clearly.

I request the hospital to ensure proper and careful eye testing, as such mistakes can cause serious inconvenience to patients.

I would not recommend this hospital for eye check-ups. Please double-check your prescription or consider another clinic.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Firstly “Believe in miracles” — because after so many years of consistent increase in your glass number and  reliable care from our side, it’s quite remarkable that a routine change in prescription (in fact, a reduction in your glasses number) is being treated as a mistake rather than a positive outcome.

Infact we have done the impossible ( reduced your glass number )

Vision correction can sometimes take a short adaptation period, especially when there is a change in power. It does not necessarily mean the check-up was “not done properly

For example, when a patient’s number reduces from, say, -2.00 to -1.50, the vision initially feels “different” or even unclear with new glasses. This is not because the prescription is wrong, but because the eyes and brain are still adjusting to improved vision and reduced dependence on power. Most patients adapt within a few days.

Not every change is an error — sometimes, it’s actually an improvement. But perhaps that’s the miracle that went unnoticed here.

Also, it’s disappointing that 8 years of accurate check-ups and good service were not even taken into account before posting such a strong public review.

It’s surprising how quickly years of trust and good results have been overlooked

Nonetheless, we hope we have been able to explain our side clearly enough to help you understand the situation better.

We doctors are now getting used to this type of behavior from our patients.

However that does not change our committment, we will continue to do what is best for our patents

featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Vatsal Eye Hospital was one of the worst medical experiences I’ve had.
Dr. Pritam Dedhia was shockingly disrespectful, dismissive, and completely lacking in empathy. There was no basic courtesy, no reassurance, and absolutely no sensitivity toward a patient clearly in discomfort.
During the eye examination, I was forced to keep my eye open under an extremely harsh light for an extended duration without blinking. A nurse held my head tightly from behind to stop me from moving, which felt aggressive and unnecessary. I repeatedly expressed that I was in pain and struggling, yet the procedure continued without pause.
My eyes were watering so intensely that my clothes were wet and still, there was no concern shown.
This is not how patients should be treated. No Skill no empathy.
I would strongly advise others to think twice before visiting.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
I'm sorry to hear that your experience at Vatsal Eye Hospital was so distressing. I want to assure you that our intention is always to provide quality care and respect to all patients.
Dr. Dedhia is an experienced ophthalmologist, and I'm sure the examination was conducted with the aim of getting an accurate diagnosis. The slit lamp examination can be uncomfortable, especially with bright light, but it's a crucial part of the eye exam. For the multiple complaints that you had, getting to accurate diagnosis was our priority. Everyday all our 50/60 OPD patients undergo the same routine slit lamp examination without which it is difficult for us to give you accurate treatment.

featured_reviews.name: Alqamah S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi, I hope this helps you.
I had a very positive experience with Dr. Ashish Ahuja and Dr. Nikhil Nasta at I Sight Eye Care. I visited them with significant vision issues, and from the first consultation, both doctors were calm, patient, and highly professional. They explained my condition and the need for tests like OCT and blood investigations very clearly, which really helped reduce my anxiety.

What stood out the most was their careful and step-by-step approach. They monitored my progress closely and adjusted the treatment as needed instead of rushing anything. Within a short time, I started noticing real improvement in my vision, which gave me a lot of confidence in their diagnosis and treatment plan.

The clinic is well-equipped, and the entire process  from tests to follow-ups was smooth and well-managed. The staff is also very helpful and cooperative. A special thanks to Irshad, who assisted me throughout the tests and made the whole experience much more comfortable.

I truly appreciate the care and support I received here. Highly recommended for anyone dealing with eye or vision-related issues.

featured_reviews.name: Heer Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently did my LASIK surgery with Dr. Nikhil and it was a hassle free process. He was realistic about exactly what would happen during and post procedure and answered all my numerous questions patiently. The staff at the clinic are extremely helpful and professional as well. Would definitely recommend him to all.

featured_reviews.name: Nirmala Rao
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a senior citizen and underwent cataract surgeries (both eyes within the span of a few days) at Dr. Nikhil Nasta’s I Sight Eyecare and Surgery at Dadar in early January. Dr. Nasta is very professional, compassionate and jovial, and clearly explained all aspects of the procedure to me. The facility itself is very well maintained and Dr. Nasta’s assistants are highly skilled and courteous. Overall, it’s been a great experience. I would highly recommend Dr. Nasta for procedures such as cataract surgeries.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We would like to express our sincere gratitude to Dr. Nikhil Nasta and his whole team. Very happy with the experience at I-Sight Eyecare & Surgery, Khar. The Surgical Centre is modern with latest equipment’s.

Dr. Nasta performed cataract surgery for both the eyes of my mother one week apart. He is extremely competent, polite, humble, approachable, friendly & thoroughly professional. Entire process from pre-checkup-to surgery-to post surgery follow up check-ups was extremely smooth. Dr. Nasta was involved personally from start to end – which is very comforting for the patients.

Entire staff is supportive, helpful, very quick in resolving admission & discharge papers and very co-operative & caring. Overall experience was excellent.
Thank You Doctor and the entire team for a seamless experience and support for speedy recovery of my mother!
